question: Does adding only TURN and KINDLE observations preserve the complete identity-safe draw trace, RNG, policy and results across the full frozen current-main cohort?

design.type: one-arm full-cohort observation identity preflight with a frozen common-random-number draw-trace anchor; not a gameplay-factor experiment
design.sharedAnchor: Both arms use the exact same 64 resolved root-551 policy identities, four simulation seed identities, current-main content, Duskblade Vow-5 baseline, explicit null, whole-run estimator and complete-cohort stopping rule.
design.mechanisticContrast: Remove only turns and kindles from each observed row and require exact equality with its frozen draw-trace anchor row. The draws, plays, all other trajectory fields, result, RNG cursor and policy snapshot cannot differ.
design.aliasStructure: The anchor aliases TURN and KINDLE telemetry with unavailable. No gameplay factor, candidate, payoff, acquisition priority, rarity or Ward setup level varies.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

cohandTelemetry.definition: Observation-only appends from existing TURN and KINDLE branches in the same BalanceSim._harvest_fight loop. The trace is never read by gameplay.

cohort.identity: Every policy index and seed from the sole frozen draw-telemetry arm appears exactly once in the same order in the new arm; no identity can be selected, removed, replaced or added after execution.

traceDefinition.schema: Every row has at least one TURN; turn numbers start at one and are contiguous within each fight. KINDLE may be empty; every entry has exact scalar fields and a non-negative uid. Every PLAY and KINDLE uid must previously appear in DRAW for the same fight under the frozen no-addCard-to-hand content census.
traceDefinition.scope: Observation only. This preflight estimates identity and schema, not co-hand counts, legality, policy selection, package activation, payoff, acquisition, balance or product acceptance.

estimands.pathIdentity: Exact canonical equality for all 256 paired rows after removing only turns and kindles from the new trajectory.
estimands.rngIdentity: Exact final RNG cursor equality for every pair.
estimands.policyIdentity: Exact resolved policy snapshot equality for every pair.
estimands.traceSchema: Zero schema, value, turn-sequence or not-previously-drawn faults.
estimands.notEstimated: No co-hand opportunity count, legal action, causal effect, complementarity, decision value, candidate feasibility, detector performance or optimisation benefit is estimated.

factorDisposition.candidate: None is constructed, simulated, frozen or promoted.
factorDisposition.payoffs: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate, fixed and absent.
factorDisposition.ponytailKnobs: No non-null research knob exists or is exercised.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser or fitted model is used or authorised.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python constructs the complete frozen row rectangle, executes it once, content-addresses the plan and output, performs exact paired comparisons and owns the stop/go decision.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: All 256 rows are the only look. No reserve, repair, rerun, row replacement or adaptive continuation exists.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This identity stage may authorise only a zero-row reconstruction from the resulting trace. It cannot support a causal, policy or gameplay endpoint claim.

decisionRules.success: All 256 rows complete within 90 seconds; removing only turns and kindles yields exact anchor equality; RNG and policy identities have zero mismatches; the trace schema has zero faults; and the ledger remains exact.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze exactly the TURN/KINDLE trace for one deterministic zero-row reconstruction of simultaneous Ward/Warden's-Edge co-hand opportunity. Do not add a candidate, payoff, gameplay hook, policy knob, causal row, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Any paired identity, RNG, policy, schema or ledger check fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close TURN/KINDLE telemetry without repair or rerun. Continue inside issue #421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism; do not infer a policy bottleneck or add a method.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input is unavailable, the single process cannot produce the complete output, or the decision is unavailable at 90 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the preflight inconclusive at the cap. Add no row, repair, rerun, candidate, method or protected seed.
